steps.en: Confirmed notice is marked ready for the batch
steps.id: Notice yang sudah dikonfirmasi ditandai siap masuk batch
steps.why_en: Saving an address sets no status that a batch could use.
steps.why_id: Menyimpan alamat tidak mengisi status yang bisa dipakai batch.

steps.en: Notice is added to the batch with the other updated notices
steps.id: Notice dimasukkan ke batch bersama notice lain yang sudah diupdate
steps.why_en: No court batch field or grouping logic exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada field batch court atau logika pengelompokan.

steps.en: The batch is sent for court application
steps.why_en: No code sends a court application batch; only an empty report menu exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang mengirim batch court application; hanya menu report kosong.
